summary.text: Michael Summers is the Republican and Libertarian candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 53, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Democrat Emerson Levy.
He has served on the Redmond School District 2J board, Position 2, since 2021.

paragraphs.text: Summers' term on the Redmond School District 2J board runs through 2029, according to Ballotpedia.
He was the Republican nominee for Oregon State Senate District 27 in 2024 and lost the general election to Anthony Broadman.
